scope: Only E002 entry, scene display, keyboard targets/jump support and documentation; no formal XML or upstream modification

acceptance.walk: command then actual base displacement >0.1m, wheel rotation, no fall for 10s
acceptance.height: actual L responds to two keyboard targets, no fall
acceptance.jump: motor-only action, both wheels airborne, measurable upward motion, stable landing; failed attempts retained
acceptance.GUI: real window key events and screenshots; sim time progresses past prior hold deadline
